• (00:26) - Jensen Returns
  • (33:38) - Ferrari 296 CS Stuns
  • (41:24) - Julia Black, a journalist at Vanity Fair, discusses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia and the reporting surrounding his alleged misconduct and ties to Chinese intelligence. She argues that the board acted reasonably, criticizes the market’s dependence on powerful tech leaders, and warns that major economic decisions are increasingly driven by political whims and investor sentiment rather than careful investigation.
  • (55:05) - Bill Gross discusses his career as a lifelong entrepreneur and founder of Idealab, which has launched 175 companies over 30 years. He reflects on lessons from the dot-com era and explains why AI will supercharge entrepreneurship by lowering costs, generating business ideas, and enabling small teams to solve major global problems.
  • (01:22:38) - Jay Jandrain discusses his journey from growing up in the turkey business to serving as Butterball’s president and CEO. He explains Thanksgiving demand, turkey pricing, brand strategy, processing technology, and Butterball’s efforts to improve efficiency while keeping products affordable.
  • (01:37:05) - Lincoln Murr discusses Super Take, the AI-powered investing platform he co-founded and leads as CEO. He explains how it converts users’ ideas into cross-asset portfolios, supports social collaboration and opposing trades, and recently raised a $20 million seed round.
  • (01:44:06) - Thijs Simonian discusses Worldcraft, his project that uses hundreds of AI agents to recreate the entire world at one-to-one scale in Minecraft. He explains its technical challenges, rapid growth, safeguards, and monetization, while also sharing his broader interest in games, robotics, and projects that bring people joy.
  • (01:54:16) - Elliott Potter discusses Lynq, the AI infrastructure company he co-founded and leads as CEO, which enables agents to communicate naturally through calls and texts. He explains advances in lifelike voice technology, the company’s $90 million Series B, expansion plans, agent-enabled payments, and efforts to address security and prompt-injection risks.
  • (02:03:40) - GTA 6 Breaks Sales Records
